C0829.title: BEC Scam Cases at Ubiquity and Peebles Media Group
C0829.summary: An academic paper analyzes business email compromise (BEC) incidents at Ubiquity and Peebles Media Group, where attackers used social engineering and spoofed corporate emails to manipulate employee trust and execute fraudulent transfers or leak sensitive information, illustrating the pervasive threat of BEC to businesses of all sizes.
